Kerala HC dismisses pleas to appeal FIR order in CMRL bribery case

The Kerala High Court has dismissed pleas filed by former Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and his daughter T. Veena seeking to appeal an order to register a First Information Report (FIR) in the CMRL bribery case. The pleas were dismissed by a bench of Justices K Natarajan and Johnson John. Vijayan and Veena had argued that they were not heard by the single judge before the October 9 direction to register the FIR was issued. The case involves allegations related to CMRL and Exalogic.
